scope: Explicitly injected Runtime boundary failures, after the independent native observer records the real SDK return; not unchanged native engine failures
rules:
SecRuleEngine On
SecRequestBodyAccess Off
SecResponseBodyAccess Off

cases.reason: The declared request-header boundary fails before upstream dispatch and response commit. Runtime maps this technical failure through explicitly configured default_error_status=500, not BODY_LIMIT.
Runtime requires SDK return exactly1; injected -7 after a separately recorded real SDK result is a technical error. The configured error status is500 and no backend request may occur.

The real host reset callback runs after response delivery. A logging-boundary failure must remain a technical error with cleanup; it cannot rewrite the already transmitted200 or manufacture a native body limit/Strict abort.

This explicit stock host fixture finalizes logging at request reset after delivery. The inherited generic500 expectation requires separate source-backed reconciliation for the already committed response; no original expectation is overwritten here.
